blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust for Industrial Equipment & Machinery — zero-trust by architecture, not by slide — identity, detection, resilience and ai security in one program applied to the industrial equipment & machinery operating unit of Manufacturing & Industrial.

Equipment makers pivot to outcome businesses: connected machines, service contracts and uptime guarantees replace box sales. The pivot is an engineering program — fleet connectivity, service intelligence and outcome pricing — built once, monetized for decades.

items: Connected machinery inherits product-security duties (EU CRA); firmware estates unmanaged.
Machines in the field lack telemetry; service is reactive and parts planning blind.

blocks.x: The pattern composes AI Security & Model Protection, Compliance, Audit & Digital Trust, Zero-Trust Architecture & Implementation from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Fleet connectivity/OTA, Service dispatch and parts, Outcome/uptime contracts) on Tele Medicine Platform and Driisti Smart Vision Glasses. Governance inherits the sector frame — EU Machinery Regulation/CRA among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Secure the models themselves — prompt-injection defense, agent containment and AI red-teaming.
Assume breach, plan recovery — resilience engineered, rehearsed and measured.
Evidence once, audit anywhere — compliance automation across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, DORA and privacy.
SBOM, signed firmware, vulnerability SLAs (CRA duties evidenced)
